Name: Daffodils Are Flowers
Author: ghostnoiz
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]i always found it weird that daffodils are considered forage instead of flowers. the description says they make a nice gift, but none of the townies seem to think so. recategorizing them as flowers should remedy this[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]- install via smapi[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]or[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]- manually add the [CP] Daffodils Are Flowers into your mods folder [/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]- recategorizes daffodils as flowers[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]- SHOULD be liked for anyone who likes flowers, and disliked by anyone who doesn't[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]- added a manual override to make sure that daffodils are still properly disliked by sam and jodi, to respect sam's allergies[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]- may or may not function with modded npcs, but I can sure try to add some manual overrides like above if it misbehaves[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Content Patcher[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
shout out to the npc i've been developing who has daffodils as a loved gift, and are a very important symbol in his story arc. he keeps complaining in the back of my head about daffodils not being appreciated enough, and it annoyed me into making this. 

[b][size=4]Future ideas [/size][/b]
[size=3]might figure out how to add some custom dialogue for the sake of funsies and immersion. might. maybe. we'll see :P[/size]

Manifest.Name: Daffodils Are Flowers
